vulnerabilities.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Search
vulnerabilities.description: The search parameter reflects unsanitized input allowing stored XSS.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement output encoding and Content Security Policy headers.

vulnerabilities.name: Directory Traversal
vulnerabilities.description: File download endpoint allows path traversal to read arbitrary files.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate and sanitize file path inputs. Use a whitelist of allowed directories.
